title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
abstract: arXiv:2610.32179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

translated_title: 稀疏历史搜索：基于不完整搜索日志与零成本代理的跨任务架构搜索
translated_abstract: 神经架构搜索（NAS）成本高昂，但跨任务迁移可以通过重用先前任务的知识来降低成本。然而，现有方法在稀疏搜索历史和任务特定迁移失败的问题上表现不佳。我们提出了一种风险鲁棒的策略，通过基于冠军的初始化和联合成对排序器预训练，将稀疏的源任务日志与零成本代理相结合。在TransNAS-Bench-101上，该方法缓解了严重的最坏情况失败，将Micro自编码任务的最差10%排名从290降低到43，将Macro房间布局任务的最差10%排名从465降低到45。在13个单元空间目标中，该方法在平均性能和最坏情况性能上均在10个目标上优于仅使用代理的排序器，同时保持了有竞争力的平均性能。
tldr: 提出一种风险鲁棒的跨任务神经架构搜索方法，通过冠军初始化与联合成对排序器预训练，将稀疏搜索日志与零成本代理相结合，显著缓解最坏情况下的失败并大幅提升最差性能。
en_tdlr: A risk-robust cross-task neural architecture search strategy that combines sparse search logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining, significantly mitigating worst-case failures and improving worst-case performance.
